purpose: Record the P22-15 command family candidate refresh after the help and doctor physical splits completed.
policy: This evidence selects the next preflight candidate only. It does not authorize moving release files, shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, output helpers, adapters, or any other command family.
completedPrerequisites: help physical split is complete and still routed through help_adapter.go
doctor physical split is complete and still routed through doctor_adapter.go
shared helper movement remains blocked after help and doctor extraction
command family dependency map accounts for every command file exactly once

selectedCandidate.reason: Release is the next best preflight candidate because it has a bounded file family, existing JSON golden coverage, release contract tests, and no direct runtime, spinner, or extracted command package dependency.
requiredPreSplitActions: add a release-family preflight evidence file before any physical move
pin release check JSON output, error envelope, artifact evidence, and skip-gate behavior
isolate local shell command execution from release output rendering through a small adapter
prove command registration, help output, stdout/stderr, and release check JSON contracts remain stable
selectedCandidate.rollbackRequirement: Restore release to deferred status and clear release from nextCandidates if release JSON, artifact evidence, command registration, stdout, stderr, or required-check drift behavior changes.

deferredCandidates.reason: Config remains deferred because it is small but still directly mutates generator config structures; first isolate config mutation from CLI parsing and output rendering.
Plugin remains deferred because registry, install, run, digest, permissions, and external process boundaries are security-sensitive and need conformance evidence before any package movement.
API remains deferred because format, import, diff, docs, middleware, and client outputs are broad external contracts tied to generator behavior.
RPC remains deferred because descriptor, protoc, scaffold, template, runtime RPC, and spinner behavior need focused golden coverage before extraction.
Model remains deferred because datasource options and generated dependency hygiene must stay stable before command package movement.
New remains deferred because service, API, RPC, goctl compatibility, profile, contract, and scaffold outputs form one generated-output surface.

blockedFamilies.reason: AI remains blocked because it is large and still couples control-plane, LLM governance, failover, streaming, manifest, project apply, and JSON output helpers.
Shared remains blocked because root wiring, JSON errors, IO, path flags, IDL helpers, template helpers, adapters, and package-wide tests are dependency sources for other command families.

nextStep.action: Create focused release family preflight evidence and tests before moving any release command files.
